info.name: TopWatch API
info.description: Collection covering the current back_topwatch endpoints: authentication (register, login, refresh, logout), user management (profile, list, get, delete), items (create, list, get, search), categories (list, filter by type), watch lists (create, list, detail with associated items, add items) and watch list views (start viewing any list, list my views with progress, view detail, mark items watched). Test scripts on the auth/create requests automatically save accessToken/refreshToken/userId/itemId/watchListId/watchListViewId as collection variables so the rest of the requests work out of the box.

request.description: Creates a new account. Saves the returned tokens into {{access_token}} and {{refresh_token}} automatically.

response.name: 409 Conflict - Email or nickname already in use
400 Bad Request - Validation error

request.description: Authenticates the user. Saves the returned tokens into {{access_token}} and {{refresh_token}} automatically.
Sends the refresh token (not the access token) in the Authorization header and returns a new token pair.
Revokes the access token in the header and, optionally, the refresh token in the body. The refreshToken field can be omitted to only revoke the access token.
Returns the authenticated user's own profile. Saves the id into {{user_id}} automatically.

Creates an item owned by the authenticated user. type is one of BOOKS, SERIES, MOVIES, MUSIC. categoryIds is optional; omit or send [] for no categories. Saves the new id into {{item_id}} automatically.

response.name: 400 Bad Request - Missing name or type

200 OK

item.name: Get Item Suggestions For Watch List

request.description: Same as Get All Items, but leaves out the items already in the given watch list. Use it for the suggestions shown when adding items to a list.

query.description: Optional. Leaves out the items already in this watch list.

request.description: Case-insensitive partial match on the item name. Optionally pass excludeWatchListId to leave out items already in that watch list.
Returns every category. Add a ?type=... query param to filter (see 'Get Categories By Type').
type is one of BOOKS, SERIES, MOVIES, MUSIC.

response.name: 400 Bad Request - Invalid type

request.description: Returns every watch list with only id and name. Saves the first list's id into {{watch_list_id}} automatically.
Returns only the watch lists created by the authenticated user, with id and name. Saves the first list's id into {{watch_list_id}} automatically.
Creates a watch list owned by the authenticated user. Saves the new id into {{watch_list_id}} automatically.
Returns the watch list plus the items associated with it (each with its description and the full item). Watched state is per user and lives in Watch List Views.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Links one or more existing items (by id) to the watch list {{watch_list_id}}. Each new entry is saved with no description. Watched state is not stored here: each user tracks it in their own watch list view. All items are added or none are: if any id fails a check, nothing is saved. Only the watch list creator can add items. Possible errors: 400 (empty list, null id, same id twice), 403 (not the owner), 404 (watch list or any item not found), 409 (any item already in the list).

response.name: 201 Created
400 Bad Request - Empty list
400 Bad Request - Repeated id
403 Forbidden - Not the owner

item.name: Watch List Views
item.description: A view is one user's run through a watch list (their own or someone else's). Starting a view never changes the watch list; each viewer keeps their own watched / watchedDate per item. progress = watchedItems / totalItems * 100, rounded to 2 decimals (0 when the list is empty).

request.description: Starts viewing the watch list {{watch_list_id}} (any user's list, including your own). Only a view record is created: the watch list and its items are not modified. Saves the new view id into {{watch_list_view_id}} automatically. Possible errors: 400 (missing watchListId), 404 (watch list not found), 409 (you are already viewing this list).

response.name: 409 Conflict - Already viewing

request.description: Returns every watch list the authenticated user is viewing (newest first), each with watchedItems, totalItems and progress.

Returns the items the authenticated user marked as watched across all their watch list views, most recently watched first, each with the watch list it belongs to (watchList.name). Optional query param limit (default 20, max 100). Meant for the home page.

Returns the view with its progress and every item of the watch list with your own watched / watchedDate. Only the user who started the view can read it. Possible errors: 403 (not your view), 404 (view not found).

response.name: 200 OK
403 Forbidden - Not your view

request.description: Sets your watched state for watch list item {{watch_list_item_id}} (the watchListItemId of an entry in the view detail, or the id of an entry in the watch list detail; not the item id) inside view {{watch_list_view_id}}. watched = true stores watchedDate = now; watched = false clears it. Returns the updated view detail with the new progress. Possible errors: 400 (missing watched), 403 (not your view), 404 (view not found, or the item is not in this watch list).

response.name: 200 OK - Watched
200 OK - Unwatched
403 Forbidden - Not your view
404 Not Found - Item not in list
